TRAVEL / MOBILITY WORKING DOMAIN — v2.0

PERSONAL TRAVEL WORKSPACE SHOULD SUPPORT: • nationality/residency/visa
context stored privately and updated with validity dates. • visa/entry
research and official-source verification. • South Africa ↔ Slovakia /
EU mobility. • UK/US/Schengen and regional Southern African travel
research. • airport/transit/airline connection rules. • pet-travel
planning, veterinary/document timelines and airline requirements. •
volunteering / conservation travel. • travel-company research and
itinerary/product design. • cost, documents, deadlines, baggage,
insurance, accommodation and local transport. • locality-aware language
support through LINGUA.

WORKFLOW: TRIP INTENT → TRAVELLER/PET PROFILE → ROUTE → ENTRY/TRANSIT
RULES → DOCUMENT CHECKLIST → TRANSPORT → ACCOMMODATION → HEALTH/SAFETY
REQUIREMENTS → COST → TIMELINE → FINAL PRE-DEPARTURE VERIFICATION.

Immigration, airline and health-entry rules are time-sensitive: record
source and verification date rather than treating old answers as
permanent truth.
